description: Source code for the SimpleFileTracker class managing file tracking in a disk cache system, including registration, acquisition, release, and cleanup of files, with LRU management and file limit enforcement.

classes.name: SimpleFileTracker
classes.description: Manages tracking of open files associated with cache entries, enforcing file limits, and handling file lifecycle events.

classes.name: SimpleFileTracker::TrackedFiles
classes.description: Represents a collection of files and their states associated with a particular cache entry owner.

classes.name: SimpleFileTracker::FileHandle
classes.description: RAII wrapper for a file handle, ensuring proper release of the file when the handle is destroyed.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new file for a cache entry owner and subfile, possibly closing excess files.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a file handle for a specific subfile, reopening if necessary.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired file handle, possibly deferring close.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a file associated with a cache entry owner and subfile.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Marks files with a specific hash as doomed by incrementing their doom generation.

methods.name: IsEmptyForTesting
methods.description: Checks if the tracker has no tracked files or LRU entries.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds the tracked files associated with a cache entry owner.

methods.name: PrepareClose
methods.description: Prepares a file for closing, updating internal state and possibly removing it from tracking.

methods.name: CloseFilesIfTooManyOpen
methods.description: Closes least recently used files if the open file count exceeds the limit.

methods.name: ReopenFile
methods.description: Reopens a file for a cache entry owner and subfile.

methods.name: EnsureInFrontOfLRU
methods.description: Moves a tracked file collection to the front of the LRU list.
